# Module CI Test Data

This directory contains deterministic fixtures for the per-module CI matrix.
The foundation fixtures are intentionally small and validate the manifest,
filtering, and oracle helpers. Omic-specific MCI tickets expand this corpus with
edge-case fixtures for import, design, QC, normalization, DA, and report modules.

The machine-readable manifest is `manifest.json`.

## Fixture Packs

`fixture_packs.json` is the MCI-002 fixture catalog. It is generated by
`generate-fixtures.R` and currently covers:

- proteomics: DIA, DDA, TMT, and DIA+LIMPA fixture forms;
- metabolomics: LC and GC fixture forms;
- lipidomics: LC and GC fixture forms;
- fixture classes: `happy_path`, `missingness`, `duplicates`,
  `invalid_design`, `multi_factor`, `bad_names`, `nonfinite`, `small_n`,
  `large_enough_for_plots`, and `multi_assay_mixed`.

Each pack has a data TSV, a design TSV, and a JSON oracle sidecar under
`refs/<omic>/`. The sidecar records sample order, feature IDs, assay names,
expected warnings/errors, exported schema expectations, and checksums for the
selected input columns used as corruption sentinels.

Push-safe packs are labelled with `ci_lane = "push"` and
`push_safe = true`. Plot-scale packs are labelled `ci_lane = "nightly"` and
`push_safe = false` so required push jobs cannot accidentally expand into the
nightly/release corpus.
